meta.title: Duty Group
meta.description: Rally your forces once again as you seek a solution to the dilemma where the celebration should be.

units.rawText: So the problem was with the security system?
units.displayText: So the problem was with the security system?

spans.text: So the problem was with the security system?

units.rawText: Puzzle's statues are in use again this time, if memory serves me well. A repeat of the Burbank incident, perhaps?
units.displayText: Puzzle's statues are in use again this time, if memory serves me well. A repeat of the Burbank incident, perhaps?

spans.text: Puzzle's statues are in use again this time, if memory serves me well. A repeat of the Burbank incident, perhaps?

units.rawText: No, that's not the case here. The problem comes from one thing, the nerve central of the security system—
units.displayText: No, that's not the case here. The problem comes from one thing, the nerve central of the security system—

spans.text: No, that's not the case here. The problem comes from one thing, the nerve central of the security system—

units.rawText: Croque takes a deep breath as if her next words would take some mustering of nerves.
units.displayText: Croque takes a deep breath as if her next words would take some mustering of nerves.

spans.text: Croque takes a deep breath as if her next words would take some mustering of nerves.

units.rawText: <color=orange>—the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian"</color>.
units.displayText: —the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian".

spans.text: —the Super Mecha-Beast "Nian"

units.rawText: Nian? The Chinese folk legend of the spring festival?
units.displayText: Nian? The Chinese folk legend of the spring festival?

spans.text: Nian? The Chinese folk legend of the spring festival?

units.rawText: Yes. Croque used it as reference when creating the mecha, loading it with documents and files relevant to the mythical creature. It serves as a core part of the security system.
units.displayText: Yes. Croque used it as reference when creating the mecha, loading it with documents and files relevant to the mythical creature. It serves as a core part of the security system.

spans.text: Yes. Croque used it as reference when creating the mecha, loading it with documents and files relevant to the mythical creature. It serves as a core part of the security system.

units.rawText: Not only can it perform basic surveillance duties, it can also control the other statues to respond to emergency situations.
units.displayText: Not only can it perform basic surveillance duties, it can also control the other statues to respond to emergency situations.

spans.text: Not only can it perform basic surveillance duties, it can also control the other statues to respond to emergency situations.

units.rawText: It'd be able to help with creating the atmosphere, and be a nice surprise for everyone... at least that was the idea.
units.displayText: It'd be able to help with creating the atmosphere, and be a nice surprise for everyone... at least that was the idea.

spans.text: It'd be able to help with creating the atmosphere, and be a nice surprise for everyone... at least that was the idea.

units.rawText: But I never thought that the AI I got from Hannah would be incompatible with the composite parts of the mecha. As a result, it's now lost control and is lurking somewhere on the event grounds.
units.displayText: But I never thought that the AI I got from Hannah would be incompatible with the composite parts of the mecha. As a result, it's now lost control and is lurking somewhere on the event grounds.

spans.text: But I never thought that the AI I got from Hannah would be incompatible with the composite parts of the mecha. As a result, it's now lost control and is lurking somewhere on the event grounds.

units.rawText: It's exhibited no inclinations towards hurting others thus far, so...
units.displayText: It's exhibited no inclinations towards hurting others thus far, so...

spans.text: It's exhibited no inclinations towards hurting others thus far, so...

units.rawText: So you hoped to keep it all undercover, but Kuro and Florence threw a wrench in your plans, right?
units.displayText: So you hoped to keep it all undercover, but Kuro and Florence threw a wrench in your plans, right?

spans.text: So you hoped to keep it all undercover, but Kuro and Florence threw a wrench in your plans, right?

units.rawText: I'm... really sorry!
units.displayText: I'm... really sorry!

spans.text: I'm... really sorry!

units.rawText: I just thought that since I created this problem, it'd not be proper for me to get anyone else involved...
units.displayText: I just thought that since I created this problem, it'd not be proper for me to get anyone else involved...

spans.text: I just thought that since I created this problem, it'd not be proper for me to get anyone else involved...

units.rawText: I see now.
units.displayText: I see now.

spans.text: I see now.

units.rawText: It is a festival, after all. The more the merrier, at least in my eyes. Though—
units.displayText: It is a festival, after all. The more the merrier, at least in my eyes. Though—

spans.text: It is a festival, after all. The more the merrier, at least in my eyes. Though—

units.rawText: I'm really really really sorry! I promise I won't let my personal desires influence my...
units.displayText: I'm really really really sorry! I promise I won't let my personal desires influence my...

spans.text: I'm really really really sorry! I promise I won't let my personal desires influence my...

units.rawText: Relax, that's not what I'm talking about. What I mean is that even if you've caused some type of problem, you don't need to shoulder it all yourself.
units.displayText: Relax, that's not what I'm talking about. What I mean is that even if you've caused some type of problem, you don't need to shoulder it all yourself.

spans.text: Relax, that's not what I'm talking about. What I mean is that even if you've caused some type of problem, you don't need to shoulder it all yourself.

units.rawText: You can rely on those beside you more. Like me.
units.displayText: You can rely on those beside you more. Like me.

spans.text: You can rely on those beside you more. Like me.

units.rawText: As I speak, I begin issuing commands through a terminal.
units.displayText: As I speak, I begin issuing commands through a terminal.

spans.text: As I speak, I begin issuing commands through a terminal.

units.rawText: The Security Department's already primed their surveillance instruments on the festival. The controls have been linked to your personal terminals.
units.displayText: The Security Department's already primed their surveillance instruments on the festival. The controls have been linked to your personal terminals.

spans.text: The Security Department's already primed their surveillance instruments on the festival. The controls have been linked to your personal terminals.

units.rawText: The Logistics Department's operand packages should arrive in twenty minutes. Make sure you have hardware prepared for receiving it.
units.displayText: The Logistics Department's operand packages should arrive in twenty minutes. Make sure you have hardware prepared for receiving it.

spans.text: The Logistics Department's operand packages should arrive in twenty minutes. Make sure you have hardware prepared for receiving it.

units.rawText: Sorry, Professor... for troubling you with all of this.
units.displayText: Sorry, Professor... for troubling you with all of this.

spans.text: Sorry, Professor... for troubling you with all of this.

units.rawText: You've gotta treat me to something nice to eat later. I've just happened to be out of cola and chips here.
units.displayText: You've gotta treat me to something nice to eat later. I've just happened to be out of cola and chips here.

spans.text: You've gotta treat me to something nice to eat later. I've just happened to be out of cola and chips here.

units.rawText: Yeah! Of course, I'll bring Sakuya and Horizon as well.
units.displayText: Yeah! Of course, I'll bring Sakuya and Horizon as well.

spans.text: Yeah! Of course, I'll bring Sakuya and Horizon as well.

units.rawText: Professor, those hardly count as fine cuisine...
units.displayText: Professor, those hardly count as fine cuisine...

spans.text: Professor, those hardly count as fine cuisine...

units.rawText: Ahaha, don't mind those little details so much. So, can I leave the rest to you, Croque, Sakuya?
units.displayText: Ahaha, don't mind those little details so much. So, can I leave the rest to you, Croque, Sakuya?

spans.text: Ahaha, don't mind those little details so much. So, can I leave the rest to you, Croque, Sakuya?

units.rawText: Don't worry, Professor.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Professor.

spans.text: Don't worry, Professor.

units.rawText: I'll find and fix up the mecha ASAP. I won't let the festival's construction progress be delayed!
units.displayText: I'll find and fix up the mecha ASAP. I won't let the festival's construction progress be delayed!

spans.text: I'll find and fix up the mecha ASAP. I won't let the festival's construction progress be delayed!

units.rawText: Safety first.
units.displayText: Safety first.

spans.text: Safety first.

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Beeeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeeep—

units.rawText: A third party joins the conversation.
units.displayText: A third party joins the conversation.

spans.text: A third party joins the conversation.

units.rawText: Aki? Have you found Kuro?
units.displayText: Aki? Have you found Kuro?

spans.text: Aki? Have you found Kuro?

units.rawText: Out of control? Okay, I got it!
units.displayText: Out of control? Okay, I got it!

spans.text: Out of control? Okay, I got it!

units.rawText: Do we have a new problem?
units.displayText: Do we have a new problem?

spans.text: Do we have a new problem?

units.rawText: The entire security system's going haywire. We've gotta get moving.
units.displayText: The entire security system's going haywire. We've gotta get moving.

spans.text: The entire security system's going haywire. We've gotta get moving.

units.rawText: Sakuya, come on!
units.displayText: Sakuya, come on!

spans.text: Sakuya, come on!

units.rawText: I subconsciously rub my chin as I watch message after message pop up.
units.displayText: I subconsciously rub my chin as I watch message after message pop up.

spans.text: I subconsciously rub my chin as I watch message after message pop up.

units.rawText: Overtime again for me, huh?
units.displayText: Overtime again for me, huh?

spans.text: Overtime again for me, huh?

units.rawText: Inside the event grounds.
units.displayText: Inside the event grounds.

spans.text: Inside the event grounds.

units.rawText: Croque and Sakuya make for the center of the festival grounds as they receive support from the Professor.
units.displayText: Croque and Sakuya make for the center of the festival grounds as they receive support from the Professor.

spans.text: Croque and Sakuya make for the center of the festival grounds as they receive support from the Professor.

units.rawText: The security system's using more and more operands, trending towards crossing the standard line at its peak.
units.displayText: The security system's using more and more operands, trending towards crossing the standard line at its peak.

spans.text: The security system's using more and more operands, trending towards crossing the standard line at its peak.

units.rawText: Can we still not pin down its location? If this continues, the Security Department's going to intervene!
units.displayText: Can we still not pin down its location? If this continues, the Security Department's going to intervene!

spans.text: Can we still not pin down its location? If this continues, the Security Department's going to intervene!

units.rawText: If it gets that bad, even if the Professor and Persicaria are still onboard, the festival's all but done for!
units.displayText: If it gets that bad, even if the Professor and Persicaria are still onboard, the festival's all but done for!

spans.text: If it gets that bad, even if the Professor and Persicaria are still onboard, the festival's all but done for!

units.rawText: I know! I'm trying!
units.displayText: I know! I'm trying!

spans.text: I know! I'm trying!

units.rawText: Operand peaks focusing, verifying coordinates, marking guided route...
units.displayText: Operand peaks focusing, verifying coordinates, marking guided route...

spans.text: Operand peaks focusing, verifying coordinates, marking guided route...

units.rawText: Done! Found you, "Nian"!
units.displayText: Done! Found you, "Nian"!

spans.text: Done! Found you, "Nian"!

units.displayText: With a flash on the screen, a series of icons signifying security units appear on the map.

spans.text: With a flash on the screen, a series of icons signifying security units appear on the map.

units.rawText: Those are...
units.displayText: Those are...

spans.text: Those are...

units.rawText: It's surrounded itself with a blockade of the statues. We'll have to get past their defenses first!
units.displayText: It's surrounded itself with a blockade of the statues. We'll have to get past their defenses first!

spans.text: It's surrounded itself with a blockade of the statues. We'll have to get past their defenses first!

units.rawText: Aki said they were out of control, but for it to act this quickly...
units.displayText: Aki said they were out of control, but for it to act this quickly...

spans.text: Aki said they were out of control, but for it to act this quickly...

units.rawText: Let's go, Sakuya, prepare for combat!
